name: Social Styles Profile
excerpt: Social Styles Profile categorizes people as drivers, expressives, analyticals, or amiables.
notes: The Social Styles Profile is a model that categorizes people into four types: Drivers (proactive and task-oriented), Expressives (proactive and people-oriented), Analyticals (reactive and task-oriented), and Amiables (reactive and people-oriented).
context_summary:
- Categorizes people into four types.
- Types include Drivers, Expressives, Analyticals, and Amiables.
